title: Speech Descriptors Formats V1.5
description: Speech descriptor content formats. Uses oneOf with const+description so each value is self-documented.

oneOf.description: Classic short-term spectral features (typically 13-40 cepstral coefficients per frame) widely used as the acoustic front-end for speech and speaker processing.
Log Mel-scale filterbank energies per frame; a common neural-network acoustic front-end retaining more detail than MFCC.
Perceptually-motivated linear-prediction features approximating properties of human hearing.
Total-variability factor-analysis speaker embedding (Dehak et al. 2011); a fixed low-dimension vector compared by cosine or PLDA scoring.

Emphasized Channel Attention, Propagation and Aggregation TDNN speaker embedding (Desplanques et al. 2020); a 192-dimension L2-normalised descriptor compared by cosine similarity. Used by SpeechBrain and 3D-Speaker.
TDNN speaker embedding with statistics pooling (Snyder et al. 2018); a fixed-dimension descriptor compared by cosine or PLDA scoring.
Frame-level DNN/LSTM speaker embedding averaged over an utterance (Variani et al. 2014); used for text-dependent and text-independent verification.
ResNet backbone with squeeze-and-excitation blocks and attentive statistics pooling producing a speaker embedding compared by cosine similarity.
Context-aware masking TDNN speaker embedding (2023) with improved efficiency and accuracy over ECAPA-TDNN.
Reshaped-dimension network speaker embedding (2024) achieving strong verification accuracy at low parameter count.
Speaker embedding derived from the self-supervised WavLM foundation model (Chen et al. 2022), typically pooled from transformer representations.
Speaker embedding derived from the self-supervised Wav2Vec 2.0 foundation model (Baevski et al. 2020).
